package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func TestPracticeReadinessProductionComposition(t *testing.T) {
	store := postgres.Store{}
	resolver := newPracticeLearningResolver(store, &t07StudentMasteryFixture{}, systemClock{})
	if resolver.Readiness == nil {
		t.Fatal("production practice resolver omits the PostgreSQL readiness repository")
	}
	if actual, ok := resolver.Readiness.(postgres.Store); !ok || actual.Pool != store.Pool {
		t.Fatal("production readiness must use the same PostgreSQL store as the frozen route")
	}
}

func TestPracticeReadinessMissingDependencyFailsClosed(t *testing.T) {
	student := &t07StudentMasteryFixture{mastery: []domain.TargetMastery{{
		Target: t07Target, State: domain.MasteryMastered, MasteryScore: 1,
		Confidence: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion,
	}}}
	resolver := newPracticeLearningResolver(postgres.Store{}, student, systemClock{})
	resolver.Readiness = nil
	input := domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestV1{
		Schema: domain.PracticeLearningReadinessRequestSchemaV1, StudentID: uuid.NewString(),
		TaskInstanceID: uuid.NewString(), TaskRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), RouteID: uuid.NewString(),
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64),
		RouteDigest:        "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), StepID: "board",
	}
	receipt, created, err := resolver.ReconcileReadiness(context.Background(), uuid.NewString(), input)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || created || receipt.ID != "" || receipt.Decision != "" || student.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("missing repository must deny before mastery reads, got receipt=%+v created=%v calls=%d err=%v", receipt, created, student.calls, err)
	}
}

var t07Target = domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "javascript.dom-events", Version: "v1"}

// t07StudentMasteryFixture represents the existing Student query port only.
// These composition tests do not exercise Student's evidence/mastery reducer.
type t07StudentMasteryFixture struct {
	mastery []domain.TargetMastery
	calls   int
	err     error
}

func (fixture *t07StudentMasteryFixture) QueryMastery(_ context.Context, _ string, targets []domain.TargetRef) ([]domain.TargetMastery, error) {
	fixture.calls++
	if fixture.err != nil {
		return nil, fixture.err
	}
	if len(targets) != 1 || targets[0] != t07Target {
		return nil, errors.New("unexpected target query to T07 Student mastery fixture")
	}
	return append([]domain.TargetMastery(nil), fixture.mastery...), nil
}
